matchedRules.reason: Dialer changes are call-path critical and must run package specs.
Dialer server and shared phone-normalization changes must build contacts runtime exports before proving Hono transport, Twilio boundary, and standalone lifecycle contracts.
Billing edits must prove paid-only native changes, isolated component invoices, idempotent top-ups, immutable usage debits and legacy schema upgrades against disposable PostgreSQL.
